verdict.rationale: Convertio's developer site lists "Official Wrappers" with a PHP GitHub library, so a first-party SDK exists. The evidence shows only one language and a single thin listing, and the invitation to "improve and modify them" suggests light maintenance. Missing for 10: SDKs beyond PHP, SDK reference documentation, evidence of maintenance or versioning, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
